Adani Defence Plant Foundation Laid in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh

A foundation stone ceremony was held in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, for a new Adani Defence manufacturing plant. The project involves an investment of ₹2500 crore and is expected to create employment opportunities for approximately 5,000 youths. Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia and Chief Minister Mohan Yadav were present at the event.
